summary: Corrected the misattributed parliamentary-question claim, removed an unsupported methods description, restored dated 'as of August 2026' status stamps, project end dates, MINE's 2017 founding and the accurate Digit Srl and media-coverage details, and tightened the prose throughout.

flags.claim: Through empirical methodologies leveraging machine learning, natural language processing, and network analysis
flags.issue: No source describes his methods in these terms; the authoritative biography characterises his research as computational social science, digital platform analysis and political communication with a focus on information disorders and coordinated behaviour. Replaced with the supported description.

flags.claim: was cited in a written question to the European Parliament
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states the paper was cited in a European Parliament written question addressed to the European Commission (E-10-2026-000086) — the question was put TO the Commission, not to Parliament. Corrected in the revision.

flags.claim: drew wide national news coverage in Italy
flags.issue: The authoritative biography supports 'national media coverage' between January and April 2026 in four named outlets; 'wide' is an intensifier the source does not assert. Replaced with the named outlets and dates.

flags.claim: He directs the Mapping Italian News Research Program (MINE)
flags.issue: The authoritative biography states he founded MINE in 2017 and has coordinated it since, and that the programme is active 'as of August 2026'; the biography dropped the founding and the dated status stamp. Restored.

flags.claim: serving as Work Package Leader on the Horizon Europe project vera.ai and as a partner on the PROMPT initiative
flags.issue: Both projects concluded (vera.ai October 2025, PROMPT February 2026) per the authoritative biography; omitting the end dates risks presenting concluded roles as ongoing. Dates added.

flags.claim: evaluated project proposals for the European Education and Culture Executive Agency
flags.issue: The authoritative biography stamps this as a current appointment: as of August 2026 it ran to September 2026. The past-tense phrasing misrepresents its status; revised to the stamped formulation. (The specific call and contract details are correctly omitted.)

flags.claim: civic participation, environmental sustainability, and scientific dissemination
flags.issue: The authoritative biography says Digit Srl develops platforms for sustainability, civic participation, social innovation and scientific dissemination; 'environmental' is an unsupported qualifier and 'social innovation' was dropped. Corrected.

flags.claim: Fabio Giglietto is Full Professor of Internet Studies ... He maintains active ties with international scholarly organizations
flags.issue: These status claims are stamped 'as of August 2026' in the authoritative biography but were rendered as timeless present tense. Stamps restored in the revision.

flags.claim: investigates the structural mechanics of online information disorders ... across digital platform ecosystems
flags.issue: Abstraction-heavy, jargon-dense phrasing ('structural mechanics', 'platform ecosystems') that adds no verifiable content; tightened to plainer, source-backed language.
